recentItems.title: A.I. Outrage: Nvidia CEO Reinstated, Anthropic Goes Public, Service Outages. What You Need to Know
recentItems.description:
Elizabeth Schulze has the latest on Jensen Huang being reinstated as the CEO of Nvidia just days after his resignation. Plus, Anthropic has officially gone public, a string of technical outages has people asking if artificial intelligence is to blame, Kroger announces major layoffs, Apple plans to launch a new health tool, an Arizona man was released from custody after the officer used A.I. in his report, and General Motors is using virtual crash simulations to make their vehicles safer, along with other headlines you need to know.
 
 
00:35: HUANG REINSTATED: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang was reinstated as CEO and Chairman.  
01:27: NVIDIA EARNINGS: Nvidia is delivering a reported revenue of 115.8 billion dollars.
02:11: NVIDIA STOCKS: Nvidia's stocks account for about 6% of the entire S&P 500.
02:40: ANTHROPIC: The A.I. Giant goes public, making it the biggest IPO on record.
03:20: STRING OF OUTAGES: Several companies have all cited technical issues for their service outages.
03:56: A.I. RESHAPING FUTURE WORK: Kroger says it plans to eliminate three thousand corporate jobs over the next three years.
04:30: 65% "HIGH RISK" TO JOBS: 65% of Americans say A.I. poses a high risk of eliminating many jobs.
04:39: APPLE A.I. HEALTH TOOL: Apple is launching a new A.I. health chatbot as part of a research study.
05:05: GOOGLE A.I. BACKLASH: Google is facing pressure over a new A.I. policy.
05:26: A.I. ARREST REPORT: A DUI suspect was released after an officer used artificial intelligence in his arrest report.
05:46: GM CRASH TEST A.I.: General Motors is using virtual crash simulations to identify potential safety issues and make design changes.

--
Watch more episodes of What You Need to Know streaming on @disneyplus: https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-c99a2244-2ec4-449a-9dde-8b09a408f923
